title: Support relation: for w ∈ B_2(0), w ∈ spt μ₀ ⟺ z + r·w ∈ spt μ (parent steps 0(d),(e), 1)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, z ∈ ℝ^P, r > 0 and μ₀ := ofReal(r⁻¹^n)•(μ⌞B_{2r}(z)).map(dilation z r). Then for every w ∈ B_2(0): (μ₀(B_ε(w)) ≠ 0 for every ε > 0) ⟺ (μ(B_ε(z + r·w)) ≠ 0 for every ε > 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → μ₀ = ENNReal.ofReal (r⁻¹ ^ n) • (μ.restrict (ball z (2 * r))).map (dilation z r) → ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid P) 2, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ₀ (ball w ε) ≠ 0) ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ (ball (z + r • w) ε) ≠ 0
